topic.title: Chat History Dialog Box
topic.shortdesc: Find, organize, open, export, import, or delete conversations saved for the current project.

body.p: The Chat History dialog box lists all conversations saved for the current project. To open it, select Show all history from the History menu in the AI Positron view.

Pinned conversations are listed first, under the Pinned heading. The remaining conversations are grouped by the day on which they were last changed: TODAY, YESTERDAY, and then the date. Each row shows a title and description. The description is also available as a tooltip.

To open a conversation, select it and click Open in chat. You can also double-click it or press Enter. The conversation loads in the chat, and the dialog box closes. Click Close or press Escape to close the dialog box. If a menu is open, Escape closes the menu first.
Use the arrow keys to move through the conversation rows (the day headings are skipped). Hold Shift or Ctrl to select multiple conversations.

section.title: Manage Conversations
section.p: Right-click one or more selected conversations to access the following actions. Right-clicking selects the row under the pointer unless that row is already part of a multiple selection. The actions then apply to the entire selection.

dlentry.dd: Loads the selected conversation in the chat and closes the dialog box. This action is available only when exactly one conversation is selected.

Allows you to change the title of one selected conversation. The title becomes editable in the list, with the current title selected. Type a new title and press Enter to keep it, or press Escape to cancel. Clicking elsewhere or closing the dialog box also keeps the new title. This action is available only when exactly one conversation is selected.
Pins or unpins the selected conversations. The action is named Unpin only when all selected conversations are already pinned. Otherwise, it pins the selected conversations that are not yet pinned.
Saves one selected conversation to a file, or multiple selected conversations to an archive.
Removes the selected conversations from the history. The dialog box actions are disabled while the deletion is in progress.

section.p: A renamed conversation keeps its place in the history because renaming does not change its last-modified date. If the renamed conversation is currently open in the chat, its title is updated there as well. A conversation cannot be renamed while its title and description are being generated by AI.

The Delete, Import..., and Export all... actions are also available to the left of the dialog box buttons. Actions shared by the dialog box and the contextual menu have the same availability in both locations.

section.title: Pin Conversations
section.p: Pin a conversation to keep it at the top of the Chat History dialog box and History menu. Pinned conversations remain available there even when newer conversations would otherwise push them out of the recent list.

In the Chat History dialog box, pinned conversations appear at the top of the list (under the Pinned heading) and are ordered from newest to oldest. Recent conversations never displace pinned conversations. They are not repeated under the heading for their last-changed day. Their rows show the complete date and time rather than only the time.

In the History menu, hover over a conversation to view its description in a tooltip and display buttons to pin or rename a conversation. The menu remains open and the conversation moves to its new position.
Pins are stored separately for each project. They are retained when you restart the application, but are not exported or imported with conversations. Deleting a conversation also removes its pin.

section.title: Search the History
section.p: Type in the search field above the list to filter conversations as you type. A conversation is listed only if it matches every word you type. A word can match at its beginning.

By default, the search includes each conversation's title, description, starting action (if applicable), and the day heading and date on which it was last changed. For example, you can search for "today", "2026-09-30", or "pinned". Searching for "pinned" lists all pinned conversations, even though their rows are grouped separately.

To search the messages in conversations as well, open Search options (the gear button beside the search field) and select Include message content. You can also select the Include message content link in the final row of the results. When message content is included, use the Exclude message content link in that row to return to the default search scope. This option is retained the next time that you open the dialog box.

Title and description matches are displayed immediately. After you stop typing, the application reads matching messages in the background and displays a Searching... row until the search finishes. Only text displayed in the chat is searched; hidden context sent to the AI and tool-call arguments and results are excluded. Searches for a single letter do not read message content.
